title: params.json
description: R-D3: the complete resolved parameter set, one entry per declared parameter, each {value, source}. Written before the first step and never rewritten. Names are namespaced `component.name` (R-D2.2): at least one dot. `source` is `default`, `cli`, or `<scheme>:<detail>` (env:QS_SINK_TAU, file:qstar.toml, control:7f3a, agent:name, restart); the plan gives examples only, so any lowercase scheme is accepted. The key hashes the values only, never the sources.
